evidence.quote: I remain willing to raise the federal funds rate at a future meeting should the incoming data indicate that progress on inflation has stalled or reversed.
After seeing considerable progress on slowing inflation last year, we have not seen further progress over the first quarter of this year.
I expect inflation to remain elevated for some time.
recent employment reports show a continued tight labor market, with the unemployment rate remaining below 4 percent
I still see a number of upside inflation risks that affect my outlook.
to continue to reduce the Federal Reserve's securities holdings.
